name: bible-graph
description: An open, machine-readable prerequisite graph of the Bible — directional 'read A before B' edges across the 66-book canon, with an additive deuterocanonical layer and curated reading paths.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-verse-index.mjs && node scripts/make-viewer.mjs
scripts.validate: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/check-verse-spans.mjs && node scripts/validate-path-order.mjs --all
